h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thiruvananthapuram

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thiruvananthapuram

items.pText: Office campuses at Technopark and the government offices of the state capital employ many young parents, and some now run creches or day-care centres with a small outdoor play area. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these, as well as for schools, apartment projects and city parks in Thiruvananthapuram. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,290 km away.

Kerala's capital gets rain from two monsoons, the south-west from June and the north-east from October, and sites near Kovalam and Shanghumugham also get salt air. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit this weather. Our team or a dealer in south India installs the equipment once it reaches the city by road. Send the size of the outdoor space and the ages of the children in the day-care, and we will reply with a layout drawing.

richText.heading: Outdoor play areas for office creches and day-care centres

c: A creche play area is usually small, fenced and used by children aged 1 to 5 in short, supervised turns. Pick low pieces such as spring riders, a short
and a small play station. Leave out tall towers and fast merry-go-rounds.

Facility managers usually want the space easy to clean and quick to dry after rain. Rubber flooring drains faster than grass and can be swept every day. Put the play area next to the creche door, inside the campus fence, with room for a carer's bench. For an outdoor gym for staff, see our

facts.value: About 1,290 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What equipment suits a day-care play area?
items.a: Low, slow pieces such as spring riders, a short slide, a small play station and a toddler swing. Lay rubber flooring underneath and fence the area so carers can watch every child.

items.q: How does the equipment handle two monsoons a year?
items.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic do not rust. Give the base a drainage slope, and rinse off salt from time to time if the site is close to the coast.

items.q: Do you supply corporate campuses in Thiruvananthapuram?
items.a: Yes. We send a layout drawing your facility team can approve, then manufacture in Vasai, deliver by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.
